name: Crumbling World
venue_amount_accounting: author_says_yielding_or_sales; no audited standardized net settlement basis
interpretation: The $10k marketing spend was a cross-store campaign expense, not an itch-only cost.
This is a chosen negative postmortem, not a sampled first-commercial seller cohort.
Steam, itch.io, Apple and Game Jolt do not have identical launch conditions or buyer exposure.
Reported sales yields do not identify standardized gross revenue, publisher net proceeds or personal profit.
Rushed launch, crashes, patches and refunds are qualitatively documented; no causal contribution can be quantified.
Jam popularity and follower count do not establish paying buyer demand.
